title: Prove normalized rewrites over reshaped ite terms and wide flattenings
summary: The Lean reconstructor now proves rewrites where Z3 reshapes Real ite terms, by matching ites through value tables, and rewrites between nested and flattened wide disjunctions, by linking equal structures and refuting false disjuncts from bound tails. Three QF_LRA smtlib-sample benchmarks that failed the Lean check now pass.
